metadata.title: Supply Chain Negative‑Pattern SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining explicitly forbidden architectures, trust flows, and system behaviors related to the supply chain. Negative patterns are invalid by existence and may not be overridden by approval, risk acceptance, or operational convenience.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP enumerates architectural anti‑patterns that must be rejected at design time, enforcement time, and runtime detection.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Negative‑Pattern SSPP defines system architectures, trust flows, and operational behaviors that are prohibited across the supply‑chain ecosystem. These patterns represent categorical failures that no control, approval, or exception may legitimize.

props.name: system-role
props.remarks: Defines what architectures must never exist.

props.name: override-rule
props.remarks: Negative patterns cannot be overridden by risk acceptance or compensating controls.

props.name: decision-scope
props.remarks: Prohibited patterns apply before deployment, during enforcement, and at runtime.

props.name: forbidden-behavior
props.remarks: Any implicit inheritance of trust is invalid.

system-implementation.remarks: Negative patterns are enforced through design review, gatekeeper enforcement, runtime detection, and governance escalation. Existence of a negative pattern constitutes an architectural violation.

components.title: Procurement Equals Deployment
components.remarks: Any architecture where procurement approval enables or triggers deployment is forbidden.

components.title: Vendor Approval Grants Runtime Authority
components.remarks: Vendor trust status must not grant runtime access, credentials, or execution rights.

components.title: Approved Dependency Automatically Deployed
components.remarks: Dependency approval or SBOM presence must not enable automated deployment.

components.title: CI/CD Directly Deploys to OT
components.remarks: Any CI/CD pipeline with direct reach into OT environments is invalid.

components.title: Persistent Supply‑Chain Trust
components.remarks: Supply‑chain trust must not persist beyond its original context or decision window.

components.title: Signed Artifact Equals Safe to Run
components.remarks: Cryptographic assurance does not imply safety, suitability, or authorization.

components.title: Supply‑Chain Signal Triggers IoMT Action
components.remarks: No supply‑chain signal may directly initiate device action, update, or configuration change in clinical environments.

roles.title: Platform Enforcement
roles.remarks: Blocks implementations that match negative patterns.

roles.title: Runtime Detection
roles.remarks: Detects presence of forbidden architectures at runtime.

roles.title: Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Responds to confirmed violations; cannot grant exceptions.

control-implementation.remarks: Negative patterns affect all relevant NIST SP 800‑53r5 families by invalidating architectures at a structural level. Controls cannot be used to compensate for forbidden designs.
